KEY_anchor_correction_T1.finding: The T1 model (R-2026-10-09, tennis_t1_stress.py) set the moment the free sources say over at stamp - 160 s, copied from the feed race. That 160 s is the lead over the Gamma ended FLAG. Against Polymarket finishedTimestamp (the stamp) the lead is a median 25 s (p25 6, p75 50; 20 live matches; first cloud-probe match 17 s). The flag comes a median 51 s after the stamp on the PC (p25 22, p75 138; probe first match 150 s).
KEY_anchor_correction_T1.consequence: Fills at T=60-180 s before the stamp happen in the last minutes of PLAY, not after the end. Re-anchored on the stamp (792 ATP/WTA singles, 14 days, B=0.995, 5 shares, price priority): join at stamp -180 s 54%, -120 s 46%, -60 s 30%, -30 s 19-24%, join at the stamp 19-21%, +15 s 15-17%, +30 s 10-13%, +60 s 8-9%, +120 s 3%. With the live lead distribution and a 15 s pipeline delay, hold to stamp+120 s: 23%; cancel at the stamp: 13%.
